Antiwar writer Scott Horton joins Joe Rogan for the landmark episode 2500. Horton runs a site that tracks American wars in grim detail. His books argue the wars were built on lies.

Rogan gives him room to lay out the full case. They trace conflicts from their stated causes to their real costs. Horton names officials and policies he holds to blame. The episode is dense, grave, and fully sourced in his telling. It suits listeners who want the antiwar case at full length, not in clips. Milestone number aside, the guest earns the slot.
